method: Publisher PDFs downloaded, cover/table text inspected and cost pages visually checked; categories follow printed group totals. Residual rounding is explicit.

studies.title: UC sample costs to establish an orchard and produce almonds, Sacramento Valley, micro-sprinkler, 2024
limitations: Only operating costs are included; cash and non-cash overhead and orchard establishment are excluded.
Per-acre operating inputs are held fixed. Harvest-dependent services and financing are not repriced when model yield or irrigation changes.
The legacy local filename says 2022, but this publication cover and table say 2024.

studies.title: UC sample costs to produce field corn, Sacramento and Northern San Joaquin Valleys, 2015
limitations: Only operating costs are included; separate cash and non-cash overhead are excluded.
Land rent and harvest-related costs remain fixed at the study per-acre amounts, not recalculated from current output prices.
